## Welcome to the Statistics Campus Blog

### Statistics, Data Analysis & Research Methods

The Statistics Campus Blog publishes scientifically grounded articles, practical examples, and reproducible tutorials on statistical methods and data analysis.

The articles are intended for students, researchers, and professionals who wish to deepen their statistical knowledge and develop practical analytical skills.

Statistical theory is combined with applications, primarily using R. Depending on the topic, the articles include mathematical formulas, statistical analyses, R code, visualizations, model diagnostics, and guidance on interpreting results.
